page.layout: One column of lexicon entries. Hebrew headwords and Hebrew forms run through the Latin glosses. No marginal notes. Printed page number top left, Hebrew running head top centre, catchword "statueret" bottom right.

main_text.p: interius, Ezech.40.19. Constr. [Hebrew: חֲצַר הַמִּשְׁכָּן] Atrium tabernaculi, Exod.27.9. Aff. [Hebrew: בְּחַצְרוֹ] In atrio ejus, 2.Sam.17.18. Pluraliter [Hebrew: חֲצֵרִים] Atria; Item Villae absque muro: [Hebrew: בֵּית הַחֲצֵרִים] Domus villarum, Lev.25.31. Constr. [Hebrew: בְּחַצְרֵי] In atriis domus Dei, Neh.13.7. Aff. [Hebrew: בְּחַצְרֶיךָ] In atriis tuis, Psalm.84.11. [Hebrew: וְאֶת־חֲצֵרֶיהָ] Et villas ejus, Josh.21.12. Et forma foemin. [Hebrew: מִן הַחֲצֵרוֹת] Ex atriis, Exod.8.13. Constr. [Hebrew: חֲצֵרוֹת בֵּית־יְהוָה] In atriis domus Domini, 2.Reg.21.v.5. Aff. [Hebrew: חֲצֵרֹתָיו] Atria ejus, Psal.100.4.

[Hebrew: חָצִיר] m. Gramen, Foenum: Item Porrum, quod Fœno sive gramini majori simile est, Num.11.5. Et femel ex praecedentis Nominis significatione, Atrium, Jesa.34.13. Quidam etiam sic exponunt cap.35.7. Constr. [Hebrew: חֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת] Gramen tectorum, Jesa.37.27.

[Hebrew: חַצְצְרָה] f. Tuba, Hos.5.8. ex geminata secundâ radicali: Plural. [Hebrew: חֲצֹצְרוֹת] Tubae, Num.10.2. Hinc Partic. ex Pih. [Hebrew: מְחַצְצְרִים] Clangentibus, q.d. Tubicinantibus, 2.Paral.5.13. Et Particip. ex Hiphil. [Hebrew: וְהַחֲצֹצְרוֹת מְחַצְצְרִים] Et tubi buccinabant sive clangebant, 2.Paralip.29.28. quae sunt cum [?] redundante, [Hebrew: מְחַצְצִירִים] autem est pro [Hebrew: מְחַצְצְרִים], cui simile in [Hebrew: עָוִיר] [?].

[Hebrew: חָקַק] Imprimere, Exprimere, Exsculpere, Et convenit cum [Hebrew: חָקַק] sequenti Verbo. Partic. [Hebrew: מְחֻקָּה עַל־הַקִּיר] Expressum in pariete, Ezech.8.10. Hithp. Futur. [Hebrew: תִּתְחַקֶּה] Imprimeris, Job.13.27.

[Hebrew: חָקַק] Descripsit, Exaravit; Expresit: Incidit, Sculpsit, Insculpsit, Exsculpsit: Incidit, Decrevit: Praet. [Hebrew: חָקוֹק עָלֶיהָ] Et describes super eum, vel incides in eum, Ezech.4.1. Partic. cum ' paragogico, [Hebrew: חֹקְקִי בְּסֶלַע] statuens vel describens in petra, Jesa.22.16. vide simile in [Hebrew: חָצַב]. Infin. cum Schurek, [Hebrew: בְּחוּקוֹ] Quum

page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed from the printed points and may have small errors; doubtful forms are marked [?]. The running head and page number are uncertain. "cum ꞩ redundante" is unclear and may be a Hebrew letter; marked [?]. The final "Quum" is the last line; "statueret" is the catchword below it.
